effort.basis: Initial plan from the record's Check at featurePlans adoption; estimate, owner may revise. Re-estimated 2026-11-11 in agent hours (harness 5.6.0): 2 hours agent + 1 hour owner; signing and notarization pipeline; the owner provides the Developer ID account and checks Gatekeeper on a clean account. Method: NERV merge history (50 feature and fix PRs #140–#276, previous merge to merge: median 0.56 h, p75 2.1 h, p90 5.1 h) and B-046-T02 (2-day estimate, about 0.75 h stated to implement) put a focused day at about 1.5 agent hours, with 0.75 h the least for one PR with review and CI. Estimate, not a measurement; baselineDays 2 kept as history.
